notes: The ChatGPT backend's model catalog: GET {chatgpt_base}/codex/models?client_version=<codex-cli-semver>, body ModelsResponse {"models":[ModelInfo]}. client_version is appended by codex-rs's ModelsClient on every request and is REQUIRED upstream — omitting it is a 400, and a stale/unknown value makes the backend silently filter the catalog to nothing, which is why an empty catalog is treated as a skip rather than as 'upstream dropped every model'. ModelInfo.slug is the wire model identifier (the value a /codex/responses request carries); display_name is the label the CLI's picker shows. The rest of the manifest describes the CLI's own UI (reasoning presets, shell tool type, visibility, priority) and is ignored by the sync. TRANSCRIBED from the codex-rs type definitions rather than read live: the endpoint requires a signed-in ChatGPT account token. Only the field spellings the types state (slug, display_name, description, default_reasoning_level, supported_reasoning_levels[].effort/description, shell_type snake_case, visibility lowercase, supported_in_api, priority, context_window) are encoded here; the models are the slugs the CLI's bundled catalog ships (gpt-5.6-codex, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4-mini).
